name: Deploy Monorepo to Azure

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master

jobs:
  # SPÅR 1: BYGG OCH DEPLOY FÖR API
  deploy-api:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0'

      - name: Restore & Build API
        run: |
          dotnet restore
          dotnet build --no-restore --configuration Release
          dotnet publish --no-build --configuration Release --output ./publish
        working-directory: src/api-carrental

      - name: Azure Login
        uses: azure/login@v2
        with:
          creds: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CREDENTIALS }}

      - name: Deploy API to Azure
        uses: azure/webapps-deploy@v3
        with:
          app-name: 'apiprojbilar'
          package: './src/api-carrental/publish'

  # SPÅR 2: BYGG OCH DEPLOY FÖR MVC
  deploy-mvc:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0'

      - name: Restore & Build MVC
        run: |
          dotnet restore
          dotnet build --no-restore --configuration Release
          dotnet publish --no-build --configuration Release --output ./publish
        working-directory: src/mvcsource

      - name: Azure Login
        uses: azure/login@v2
        with:
          creds: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CREDENTIALS }}

      - name: Deploy MVC to Azure
        uses: azure/webapps-deploy@v3
        with:
          app-name: '(DIN_MVC_APP_SERVICE_NAME)'
          package: './src/mvcsource/publish'
